purpose: Fail closed before applying a transformer/auditor whose structural assumptions belong to an older Stage1 representation epoch.

legacy_packed_parameter_candidate_builde.reason: The builder creates ir_parameter_records and is invalid once packed or explicit parameter metadata is already materialized.

legacy_packed_local_candidate_builder_fr.reason: The CLI rebuilds the packed-parameter candidate from the canonical baseline before adding ir_local_records.

legacy_ir_v2_full_chain.reason: The historical chain owns the old compaction/packed-parameter/packed-local progression and must not be replayed over explicit metadata.

explicit_parameter_local_metadata_consum.reason: Consumes the explicit parameter and local metadata representation rather than historical packed candidate records.

final_stage1_certification.reason: Final Stage1 evidence requires explicit parameter/local metadata and rejects legacy packed representations.

rules: compatibility is evaluated against the exact current source bytes, never a remembered HEAD label
a source-SHA lock remains mandatory even when epoch compatibility passes
epoch compatibility is necessary but not sufficient for native qualification
mixed or partial representation epochs fail closed before profile evaluation
